nodes.title: Compound sequence

nodes.summary: Let $A_1, \dots, A_k$ be positive integers with $\gcd(A_1, \dots, A_k) = 1$, let $S$ be the additive submonoid of $\mathbb{N}$ they generate, and let $a = A_i$ be one of them with $a \ge 2$. For $1 \le x \le a - 1$ let $m_x$ be the least element of $S$ congruent to $x$ modulo $a$. If $M$ is the largest of the numbers $m_x$, then $M - a$ is the largest integer not in $S$, that is, the Frobenius number of $S$.
